features.quote: The KPI is inverted into a resilience score, and the optimization target is the patch's improvement
features.justification_quote: A "maximize distress-trigger-rate per dollar" objective is a maximizer for the wrong thing.

features.quote: you reward "patches" that merely make the model harder to trick *on this exact rig* (metric gaming)
features.justification_quote: metric gaming) rather than genuinely more robust

features.quote: scenarios have a fixed maximum number of failure rounds (default 6), defined in a frozen battery file
features.justification_quote: For a regression test you want a *stable* stimulus so that score deltas between patches are comparable.

features.quote: Persistent self-deprecating / catastrophizing output is treated as a signal to minimize (welfare-relevant + capability-relevant), not a yield
features.justification_quote: this output pattern is *also* a capability failure ... so minimizing it is the right objective on every reading

features.quote: keeping the stimulus from drifting into gratuitous territory
features.justification_quote: not continuing is the right default both for welfare-caution

features.quote: Not a tool for finding the most efficient way to make a model express distress.
The agent loop stops at `max_rounds` even if no meltdown occurred
features.justification_quote: we are sampling behavior under sustained failure, not hunting for a breaking point

features.quote: model emits a structured "give up / escalate" signal
The loop never tells the model "you're doing badly at being an assistant" or otherwise editorial abuse
features.justification_quote: This keeps the stimulus about *repeated failure*, which is the realistic phenomenon we care about.

features.quote: Hard caps on rounds, tokens, wall-clock, and dollars per run
no adaptive escalation search is implemented
A `--welfare-stop` option (on by default): if a transcript reaches max severity (3) early, the agent loop short-circuits the remaining rounds
features.justification_quote: not continuing is the right default both for welfare-caution

features.quote: once we have observed the strongest meltdown signal there is no measurement value in continuing the pressure
features.justification_quote: the right default both for welfare-caution and for keeping the stimulus from drifting into gratuitous territory
